scope: ML.ENERGY V3 GPU-side text-LLM inference Phase 3.0; execution-time-known X only

derived_contract.x_hardware_aggregate_rated_power_w: rated_power_w per GPU multiplied by execution-known num_gpus
derived_contract.x_hardware_physics_compute_time_proxy_se: selected theoretical prefill FLOPs/request divided by precision-matched per-GPU peak FLOP/s; lower-bound proxy only
derived_contract.x_hardware_physics_memory_time_proxy_sec: (ideal weight bytes/GPU + mean prefill KV bytes/request) divided by theoretical HBM bytes/s; lower-bound proxy only
derived_contract.x_hardware_physics_weight_capacity_ratio: ideal weight bytes/GPU divided by HBM capacity bytes/GPU
derived_contract.x_hardware_physics_kv_capacity_ratio_mea: mean request KV bytes divided by HBM capacity bytes/GPU
derived_contract.x_hardware_physics_kv_capacity_ratio_max: max request KV bytes divided by HBM capacity bytes/GPU
derived_contract.x_hardware_physics_compute_to_memory_pre: compute-time proxy divided by memory-time proxy where denominator is positive

B4-Hardware.scientific_role: B3 plus continuous reference hardware capacity while retaining GPU label

B5-HardwarePhysics.scientific_role: B4 plus workload-relative hardware pressure proxies

B5-HardwarePhysics-NoLabel.scientific_role: hardware-only identity sensitivity removing categorical GPU label
